svg.title: What the checks cover.
svg.desc: Distinct predeclared requirements by synthetic workflow. Each requirement is checked on three repetitions in each condition, six instances. These are four authored cases, not twelve independent task samples. Mechanical and behavioral checks are separate from AI semantic ratings. Expense reconciliation: 11 mechanical, 0 behavioral, 3 AI semantic requirements. Dated action handoff: 11 mechanical, 0 behavioral, 3 AI semantic requirements. SQL report reconciliation: 12 mechanical, 0 behavioral, 0 AI semantic requirements. Merge consumer maintenance: 0 mechanical, 13 behavioral, 0 AI semantic requirements. Semantic requirements received two source-grounded AI ratings; this is not human evaluation. Process integrity remains unknown.
